tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i mchod chog nyer mkho bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti pra dzā bh+yaḥ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skabs 'dir las dang po pa la nye bar mkho ba'i lag len 'di lta bu dag yod de/ de la gsum maṇ+ḍal bsgrub mchod dam ting nge 'dzin gyi bdag 'jug dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya mchod pa'i cho ga'o//dang po ni bris sku la sogs pa rten bkram/ maṇ+ḍal 'cha' ba bdag bskyed kyi rjes su byed pa thob thang yin yang lag len stabs bde ba'i phyir skabs 'dir 'cha' na/ cho ga'i rdo rje slob dpon nam las kyi rdo rje slob dpon de rang skad cig gis dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur gyur/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nang mchod 'dus byas byin gyis brlabs nas/ maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ zhes brjod bzhin du maṇ+ḍal la nang mchod kyis byugs/ slar yang mtheb srin g.yon pas nang mchod nas blangs te maṇ+ḍal la chos 'byung gru gsum 'bri/ dbus su bdud rtsi'i thig le zlum po zhig bya/ de'i steng du spros pa la dga' na rdul tshon bkram ste/ chos 'byung dmar po gong ras ljang khu thig le dkar po bya/ mdor bsdus su byed na bdud rtsi'i thig le'i steng du 'bru'i tshom bu tsam 'god/ de dag gi mdun du mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ gtso bo'i zlum gtor gcig sde drug la zur gsum re re gzhan yang chos skyong dang gzhi bdag gi gtor ma sogs ji ltar 'os pa bshams/ rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya'i mchod pa dang sbrel nas byed na/ de dang nye ba'i phyogs gang yang rung bar 'chad par 'gyur ba'i maṇ+ḍal dang mchod gtor rnams kyang 'dus byas la skabs 'dir bshams pa'am 'og tu dus la bab pa'i tshe bshams pa gang bder bya'o/ /slob dpon gyi drung du nang mchod rdor dril cang te'u sogs tshogs par byas nas/ gzhan yang rol mo la sogs pa legs par bstar te/ sngon 'gro gtor ma la chab btang*/ thog mar nang mchod la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/

oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sogs/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sūr+ya sogs/ oṃ hūṃ badz+ra a na la sogs dang*/ oṃ hoḥsarba dharma sogs sngags tshan bzhis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ phaiṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya ho/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsa un man dā/ a pa smā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki ṇ+ya dā ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gṛh+ṇan tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣān tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshān+tu ya the baṃ/ ya theṣ+taṃ/ bhu dza thā/ dzi gh+ra tha/ pi pā tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kartā ya sad su kha bi shud+dha/ sa hā yi ka bhā wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ/ badz+ra dhū paṃ/ badz+ra dī paṃ/ badz+ra nai we d+yaṃ/ badz+ra ak+ṣa taṃ/ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra hā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra ba d+yaṃ/ badz+ra nṛ t+yaṃ/ badz+ra gī taṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po//rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod//rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha'i 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/

/klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*/ /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /yi dwags= /sha za'i= /smyo byed=/ brjed byed= /mkha' 'gro= /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus ji snyed mchis pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces pa'i mthar oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥhrāḥhrāḥ sogs sgrub thabs 'byung ba ltar bdud sreg pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ tsham rngam dang rom mo'i sgra bya/ de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong par gyur stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+ruṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su shel gyi snod sor bcu gnyis pa rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥrnams las byung ba'i chu dang mchod yon dang dri dang me tog dang bdug pa dang snang gsal dang zhal zas dam pa dag dang*/ rnam pa mang po'i 'bras bu ma nyams pa dang*/

gos dang rgyan dang ba dan dang bla bre la sogs pa dang*/ klu dang gar dang me long dang dril bu la sogs pa sil snyan gyi tshogs du ma dang*/ in+d+ra nī la la sogs pa rnam pa mang po'i rin po che dang*/ nang gi dam tshig rnams dang*/ dam tshig rnam pa bzhi'i rdzas la sogs pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu dpag tu med cing dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ badz+ra dhū paṃ/ badz+ra dī paṃ/ badz+ra nai we t+yaṃ/ badz+ra ak+ṣa taṃ/ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra hā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra wā d+yaṃ/ badz+ra nṝ t+yaṃ/ badz+ra gī taṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kā maṃ swāhā/ rol chen dang bcas te/ oṃ hoḥbadz+ra gaṇ+ḍe sarba dharma e ka pradz+nyā dhā ni/ swa bhā we/ sarba ā kā re/ sarba dharma pra bo dha ni/ sarba dharma ṇi swa bhā wan pra bo dha ya pra bo dha ya swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de dag ni sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o/ /dngos gzhi la dang por bdag bskyed ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ zhes pa nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi thugs kar thim/ zhes pa'i bar lha dgu'i sgrub thabs su ji skad bshad pa bzhin bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas mdun bskyed mchod pa dang bcas pa ni maṇ+ḍal bsgrub mchod dngos yin pas de bya ste/ de yang bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyas bsdus gang sgom kyang rung*/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyas pa sgom tshul dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas par bshad pa'i mdun bskyed bsgrub tshul mchod bstod gtor ma dang bcas pa rnams mtha' rgyas su byed pa ni shin tu rgyas pa yin la/ yang cho ga de nyid thugs dkyil tsam la sbyar na'ang cung zad rgyas par 'gyur zhing*/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sam thugs dkyil sa bon tsam las bskyed na'ang cho ga 'bring por 'gyur ro/ /'chad par 'gyur ba 'di ni bsdus pa yin la/

bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang yin yang de ma bsdus par de'i gzugs brnyan maṇ+ḍal la shar ba'i tshul gyis skad cig gis bskyed nas mchod pa byed pa ni shin tu bsdus pa yin no/ /'on kyang 'di ltar lag len du bya ste/ nang mchod kha gso ba tsam 'grub na legs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa nas/ a mṛ taṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā 'i bar nang mchod byin rlabs rgyas pa gtor ma byin rlabs ltar bya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ zhes lan gsum la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pa brjod maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung thig le dang bcas pa grub par mos pa tsam byas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hrāḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams la gnas pa'i brtsegs pa'i yi ge yongs su gyur pa las 'byung ba rim brtsegs lhun po dang bcas pa'i steng du thugs gsung sku'i dkyil 'khor rnams mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa phyogs kun tu ye shes kyi 'od zer mtha' yas pa kun tu 'phro ba dbang po'i gzhu dang me long gi gzugs brnyan dang pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa snang la rang bzhin med pa/ rang gi sems nyid kyi so sor snang ba gzhom du med cing rdul phra rab kyi chos las 'das pa dwangs shing sgrib pa med la phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal ba mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing rgyan gyis rnam pa mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes pa dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa gnas thams cad du lha'i gdan thams cad kyis mdzes pa'o/ /gdan rnams kyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum nus ma bcu de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum bcu/ sems dpa' yab yum bcu gnyis/ khro bo khro mo brgyad/ gzungs ma bcu gnyis te thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor ma brgyad thabs dang bcas pa rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba dang*/

'dod ma sum cu rtsa drug ste gsung gi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ lha chen po bcu gnyis so sor shes rab ma dang bcas shing*/ pad 'dab la gnas pa'i lha mo nyer brgyad nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba/ chos kyi lha sum brgya drug cu'i tshogs rnams dang*/ sgo skyong gi khro bo'i rgyal po drug po so sor yum dang bcas pa dang*/ phyir 'dod ma sum cu rtsa drug dang*/ klu rgyal chen po bcu shes rab ma dang bcas pa ste/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzhal med khang la gnas pa rnams dang*/ dur khrod 'khor lor bzhug pa'i rab gtum ma bcu thabs dang bcas pa dang*/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis grub par gyur pa ni/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bdag /srid gsum skye 'jigs med pa'i dngos/ / zhes pa nas/ srid gsum dang ba mngon du byed gyur cig / ces pa'i bar bstod chen 'don bzhin du lha rnams gsal gdab bo/ /de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ gong gi gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa dang 'dra ba las/ gnas khang bskyed chog gi tshig dor ba ste/ stong pa'i ngang las shel gyi snod sor bcu gnyis pa zhes sogs brjod pa'i khyad par tsam mo/ /de nas mchod pa'i mgron spyan drangs nas mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mchod pa'i yul du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥtrai dhā tu ke shwa ra kā la tsakra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sa pa ri wā raḥtwaṃ bha ga wān me wa ra do bha wa shi ṣ+ya naṃ tsa/ zhes pa lan gsum/ rnam dag ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu gter ni/ /rab dwangs kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs/ /zhal gyi rnyog pa'i dri sel yon chab 'di/

/dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhri pra wa ra sad kā raṃ ar+tha añtsa ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ tshig rkang dang po gnyis 'dra ba la/ zhabs kyi pad+ma'i dri ser spos kyi chu/ / zhes dang*/ pād+yaṃ/ de bzhin du/ kun tu 'pho ba'i gdung sel 'thor 'thung 'di// prok+ṣā naṃ/ yan lag brgyad ldan rdo rje ar+gha'i rgyun/ /ar+ghaṃ/ zhes pas chu bzhi phul / khams gsum dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /dus kyi 'khor lo 'khor bcas rnams/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dri mchog 'di/ /bzhes nas bdag la mchog stsol mdzod/ /oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes kun la sbyar te/ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rkang pa gsum yang snga ma bzhin kun la sbyar te/ rdo rje me tog rnam bkra'i tshogs/ / badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje bdug spos bla na med/ /badz+ra dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje sgron me 'od rab 'bar/ /badz+ra dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje zhal zas rol mchog ldan/ /badz+ra nai wi t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje ma nyams 'bras bu'i mchog / badz+ra ak+ṣa taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje sgeg mo'i mchod pa ni/ /badz+ra lā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje bzhad ma'i mchod pa 'di/ /badz+ra hā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje sil snyan rnam mang po/ /badz+ra bā t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje gar gyi mchod sprin 'di/ /badz+ra nṛ t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje glu dbyangs yid 'phrog ldan/ /badz+ra gī taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje 'dod pa'i mchod pa mchog /badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ tsa sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /dri chab ma dang phreng ba ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs sprul nas/ / dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe gan+dha artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra mā le mā la= ṭa sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ / bdug spos ma dang snang gsal ma/ /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha= /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe dhū pa=

oṃ badz+ra pra dī pe= pa sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /zhal zas ma dang 'bras bu ma/ / nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha= / oṃ badz+ra a mṛ te= oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣa te= ta sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /sgeg mo dang ni bzhad pa mo/ /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha= /oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye= oṃ badz+ra hā s+ya= ka sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /sil snyan ma dang gar mkhan ma/ /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha= /oṃ badz+ra bā d+ye= oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye= sa sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /glu dbyangs ma dang 'dod pa ma/ /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha= /oṃ badz+ra gī te= oṃ kā me sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa nāṃ kro dha ā dī nāṃ badz+ra su ra ta pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes rig ma bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku brnyes la/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog rab 'bar nor bu rin chen in+da snyil/ /gser dngul la sogs rin chen me tog dang*/ /reg na bde ba rnam mang gos kyi tshogs/ / tsan+dan la sogs dri bzang sbyar ba'i chab/ /dri zhim bdug spos bsregs pa'i sprin tshogs dang*/ /rtsi bcud 'bru mar dang bcas sgron me'i tshogs/ /grags stong gnyis su med pa dril bu'i sgra/ /gsal snang gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i me long dang*/ /lha rdzas bla bre nam mkha'i tshad 'jal byed/ /rnam mang 'bras bu sna tshogs bcud ster zhing*/ /lhab lhub g.yo ba ba dan rnam lnga'i tshogs//'jo sgeg rnam 'gyur spro ba'i gar mkhan dang*/ /sgra snyan sna tshogs rol mo'i mchod pa ste/ /

bcu gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'pho ba rab 'gags nas/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /rab dwangs yan lag brgyad ldan chu gtsang dang*/ /'o chab me tog bcas pa'i mchod yon bzang*/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i dri bzang mkha' khyab dang*/ /lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i bdug spos dang*/ /ut+pal pad+ma la sogs me tog bkra/ /ma nyams sa ha ka ra'i 'bras bu smin/ /sman mchog dbang po la sogs 'bru sna tshogs/ / nyi zla nor bu la sogs snang gsal tshogs/ /bdud rtsi ro brgya ldan pa'i lha bshos dang*/ /kañtsa li ka lha yi gos kyi mchog /mchod pa rnam bcu phul bas sa bcu thob/ /dkyil 'khor rnam bcu sgrib bral thob par shog /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /bkra shis dpal be'u g.yung drung 'khyil/ /dge ba'i don du mnga' ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi= / gser gyi 'khor lo mu khyud can/ /tshangs pa chen pos phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin= / ji ltar sngon= /'dab gyi skyon gyis ma gos pa'i/ /pad+ma dkar po phul ba ltar/ de bzhin= /ji ltar sngon= /nyon mongs bdud las rgyal ba yi/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin= /ji ltar= /gdugs dkar gser gyi yu ba can/ /phul ba de bzhin bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ / ji ltar= /re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /bum pa bzang po phul ba ltar/ / de bzhin= /ji ltar= /snyan pa phyogs bcur sgrog pa yi/ /'bud dung g.yas 'khyil phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin= /ji ltar= /na bza' gser gyi nya ris can/ / phul ba de bzhin bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal gser gyi 'khor lo dang*/ /dgos 'dod ma lus stsol ba yid bzhin nor/ /gzugs mdzes skyon kun bral ba btsun mo'i mchog /bang mdzod ma lus 'gengs byed blon po'i phul/ /yid 'ong stobs ldan glang po'i bdag po dang*/

/cang shes sprin gyi shugs can rmad byung rta/ /rgol ba kun 'joms khyim bdag dpa' bo che/ /de ltar rin chen bdun gyis dkyil 'khor mchod/ /dri med chos kun gsal ba'i me long dang*/ /g.yas 'khyil chos sgra mi zad sgrog pa'i dung*/ /dug gsum nyon mongs 'joms pa'i gi haṃ dang*/ /rtsi bcud snying po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zho/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa li khri'i rdzas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe sgrub dur pa'i rtswa/ /don mchog bla med sgrub pa bil ba'i 'bras/ bgegs dang bar chad kun 'joms yungs kar te/ /rgyal bas byin rlabs bkra shis rdzas brgyad po/ /phul bas 'gro la dge legs 'phel bar shog / nyon mongs ma lus bcom pa'i stag lpags dang*/ /sgrib pa kun bral glang chen pags pa'i gos/ /'jigs byed he ru ka dpal mnyes byed pa/ /sna tshogs na bza'i mchod pa dbul bar bgyi/ /dbang sngon karke ta na chu shel dang*/ /pad dmar ma ra ta ka mu tig dang*/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser dang dngul la sogs/ / bza' dang bca' ba rnam pa du ma dang*/ /rtsa ba sdong bu 'dab ma me tog dang*/ / ljon shing la sogs rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /bsod nams spel phyir dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /ral gri khang pa pags pa skyed mos tshal/ / mal cha gos dang mchil lham rin po che/ /pad+ma can sogs bkra shis lha mo brgyad/ /sna tshogs rin chen las grub khang bzang dang*/ /dpag bsam shing dang bum pa bzang po dang*/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang rin chen ri bo sogs/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ /kun+da rab tu khyab byed dri bzang dang*/ /rnam dag nyi mas dag byed me tog phreng*/ /don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ / 'gro bas rnam dag zla nyi thob par shog /gtum mo 'bar bas kun rtog bsregs pa'i spos/ /snying nang gzhol med 'bar ba'i snang gsal tshogs/ /don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /spros bral ye shes snang ba thob par shog

/'dod yon gzhan mchog bdud rtsi zhal zas lnga/ / thig le nor bur bcings pa'i ma nyams 'bru/ /dom dam dbyings= /stong pa'i gzugs kyi byang sems 'ching bar shog /ma dag gnas gyur ye shes sgeg mo'i lus/ /las rlung dhū tīr thim pa bzhad sgra'i dbyangs/ /dom dam dbyings= /rdo rje'i sku dang bcu gnyis sa thob shog /gzhom med nā da'i rol mo sil snyan mchog /rnam gsum phyag rgya'i rol pa bde ba'i gar/ /dom dam dbyings=/ grag stong sgra dang sgyu rtsal mchog thob shog /sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho chos nyid rdo rje'i glu/ /mi 'gyur bde sgrub phyag chen 'dod pa mo/ /dom dam dbyings= /rdo rje'i gsung dang mi 'gyur bde thob shog /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum la sogs pa ci rigs par brjod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs/ na mo sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun thams cad kyi ngo bo dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi skyob pa drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'di zhes bya ba'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dngos grub rgya mtsho yon tan rin chen gter/ /srid dang zhi ba'i gdung ba sel ba'i sman/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang la mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ nyi ma'i 'od dang zla bzang lha dbang dang*/ /gzi brjid zlas byin lha yi dbang phyug dang*/ /sna tshogs gzugs dang lha yi dbang ldan te/ /chos rgyal chen po brgyad la mchod pa 'bul/ /'jam dbyangs grags pa pad+ma dkar po dang*/ bzang po rnam rgyal bshes gnyen bzang po dang*/ /phyag na rin chen khyab 'jug sbas pa dang*/ /nyi ma grags dang shin tu bzang po'i mchod/ /rgyal mtsho rnam rgyal rgyal dka' nyi ma dang*/ /sna tshogs gzugs dang zla 'od mtha' yas dang*/

/sa skyong dpal skyong seng ge rnam gnon dang*/ /stobs chen ma 'gags mi yi seng ge mchod/ /dbang phyug chen po mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang*/ /drag po zhes bya nyi shu rtsa lnga po/ /sa yi 'khor lo rdzogs par skyong ba ste/ /tshangs pa lha dbang phyed phyed skyong rnams mchod/ /'od srung la sogs dum bur skyong ba brgyad/ /de ltar sa skyong sum cu rtsa lnga ni/ /rigs kun gcig tu mdzad pa gsang sngags kyi/ /rigs ldan brgyud pa rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /dus zhabs gnyis dang nā len+d+ra pa dang*/ /zla ba mgon po 'bro ston lo tsā dang*/ /lha rje sgom pa sgro ston gnam brtsegs dang*/ /grub chen yu mo rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /chos kyi dbang phyug nam mkha' 'od zer dang*/ /sprul sku jo 'bum grub thob se chen dang*/ /chos rje 'jam gsar chos sku 'od zer dang*/ /kun spangs chos rje rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /byang sems chen po yon tan rgya mtsho dang*/ /kun mkhyen chos rje sgra bsgyur sku mched dang*/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal nya dbon chos rje dang*/ / grub chen kun blo rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /'jam dbyangs dkon bzang nam mkha' chos skyong dang*/ /nam mkha' dpal bzang rat+na bha dra dang*/ /grol mchog zhabs dang lung rigs rgya mtsho dang*/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen te/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mngon sum ston mdzad pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ kā la tsakra ya hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ bi shwa mā ta hoḥphraiṃ swāhā/ oṃ a āḥ.aṃ aḥha hā haṃ haḥswāhā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ a ā i ī ṛ ṝ u ū l̥ l̥̄ ha hā hi hī hu hū hl̥ hl̥̄ haṃ haḥ a ā e ai ar ār o au al āl ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi yi bdag nyid dang*/ /tshad med rnam thar chos kyi phung po dang*/ /dam chos ston pa 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams te/

/skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa 'bul/ /dus 'khor rdor sems shākya thub pa dang*/ /nus ma bum pa bcu dang rdo rje bzhi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dang khro bo'i rgyal/ /rang rang lha mor bcas pa rnams la mchod/ / gzungs ma rnal 'byor ma dang 'dod ma dang*/ /tshes kyi lha dang gdengs can phyir 'dod ma/ /rab gtum gza' skar phyogs skyong zhing skyong sogs/ /phyed bcas bye ba gsum gyi 'byung po mchod/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas dang*/ / mchod yul rgya mtsho tshogs la mchod pa 'bul/ /'gro kun ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho la/ /mchog tu rol pas bde chen thob par shog /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwe bh+yoḥn mo na maḥ gzhan yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad la mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bka' sdod chos skyong bsrung ma thams cad la= yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad la= zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshim nas myur du mngon pa rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gyur cig / bstod pa ni/ rol chen dang bcas te/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ / ces pa nas/ ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ / kyi bar mtshan brjod kyi 'dud nyi shus bstod/ de nas dril bsil dang bcas te/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can sogs/ phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das sogs/ dus kyi 'khor lo bde chen po/ /sku gsum mchog dang dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje gsum mchog rdo rje dbyings/ /'gyur ba med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam rtog sgom pa las 'das pa/ /phyag rgya chen po mi 'gyur bde/ /gzung ba 'dzin pa dbyibs dag dang*/ /rtog dag dpyod pa rnam par spangs/ /dri za'i grong khyer rnam pa dang*/ /pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid sbyor/ /e waṃ yi ge de la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bskyed mdzad ma/

/skye ba dang ni 'jigs pa spangs/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa can/ /sna tshogs yum de la phyag 'tshal/ /ā li kā li snyoms 'jug dang*/ /hūṃ phaṭa yi ge sogs spangs kyang*/ /'gyur ba med las 'khrungs pa'i sku/ /dus kyi 'khor lo de la 'dud/ /kun mkhyen ye shes sku zhes pa/ khyab bdag nyi ma lta bu'i sku/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan/ /de nyid bcu drug dbye ba las/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas ni/ /rdo rje seng ge'i gdan bzhugs pa/ /lha dang lha min gyis bstod sngon/ /zla bzang gis gsol de la 'dud/ /rnam par bcas kyang rnam med bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab ma ste de yis 'khyud/ /skye 'jigs spangs pa'i 'gyur med bde ba dang ldan rgod pa la sogs bde ba spangs/ / sangs rgyas rnams kyi bskyed mdzad sku gsum rnams dang ldan zhing dus gsum yang dag rig /kun mkhyen mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan gnyis med de nyid la phyag 'tshal/ /gang la thog mtha' dbus med gnas dang 'chi dang srid pa dang ni sgra dang dri dang ro dag dang*/ /reg bya gzugs dang sems med rang bzhin dang ni skyes bu med cing 'ching dang grol dang byed po med/ /sa bon dang ni gsal bar dus med mtha' dag srid pa'i sdug bsngal bde ba nyid kyi rang bzhin med/ /mya ngan 'das pa mtshan ma med cing byed pa rnams bral yon tan med pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus dang sna tshogs la sogs rdo rje dang ni skyes bu dpe med kun 'gro spros pa med pa ste/ /ther zug tu gnas snyan dang shangs dang zhal dang spyan dang dbu dang phyag dang zhabs ni thams cad pa/ / 'byung po'i mtha' ste 'byung po'i mgon po mchog gi srid pa gsum 'dzin rgyu rnams dag gi rgyur gyur pa/ /rig pa la sogs rnal 'byor dag gis rtog bya mchog bde'i go 'phang dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal/ /spro byed nus ma'i gzugs gzhan glog gi me dang mtshungs shing nyi ma bcu gnyis dag gi gzi brjid can/

/ye shes rdo rje'i snang ba mchog gi go 'phang bgrod byed rnam par bcad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po ri bong 'dzin pa las 'dzag 'jig rten spyi bor yang dag gnas/ /bdud rtsi 'chi ba sel zhing srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byed pa thig le'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems tsam sngags kyi ngo bo lha yis yongs su bskor ba sdug bsngal dang ni bde ba'i rang bzhin te/ /dam pa rnams la zhi ba'i gzugs ni rang gis byas pa'i nyams myong mi zad rnams la mi zad pa/ /gang gis las gang rab byas rang gi sems la cho ga bzhin du de yi 'bras bu de bskyed pa/ /'jig rten dbang po sna tshogs gzugs can srid gsum bskyed mdzad rdo rje sems dpa' la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /gcig dang du ma dag kyang gcig cing mnyam dang mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab dang*/ /steng 'og kun nas dkar ljang sna tshogs kha dog chen po gcig gi gzugs te thung ngu ring po dang*/ / shin tu ring po yon tan med ces yon tan dang bcas bud med skyes pa'am skyes pa bud med min/ /gang zhig kun gyi rten gcig bha ga bzang mo mchog gi bha ga khyod la 'dud de khyod la 'dud/ / ces pa la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pas bstod/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi bdag 'jug mi byed na/ skabs 'dir sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar gtor ma phul la rjes kyis cho ga rnams bya'o/ /bdag 'jug byed par 'dod na/ thog mar bum pa sgrub dgos pas bum pa sgrub tshul ni/ bum pa bcu'am lnga la sogs pa yod na'ang legs la/ bsdu na bum pa gcig nyidal bum pa bcur mos pas chog ste/ bum pa'i steng du rnam rgyal chen po zhes bya ba dung chos bkod/ gzungs thag sogs kyang spyi dang mthun par lag len la mdzad do/ / oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las haṃ hāṃ hiṃ hīṃ hāṃ hūṃ hl̥ṃ hl̥̄ṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/

dbus su khu ba dang rdul 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ shar dang mer rkang 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ lho dang bden bral du khrag 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ byang dang dbang ldan du gci ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ /nub dang rlung du bshang ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis te bdud rtsi'i bum pa dkar po pad+ma la gnas shing pad+mas kha brgyan pa rnams su gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las dus kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i yab kyi thugs kar zla ba dang*/ yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor te/ de dag kha sbyar ba las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bum pa rnams dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ haṃ hāṃ hiṃ hīṃ huṃ hūṃ hl̥ṃ hl̥̄ṃ badz+ra pad+ma a mṛ ta gha ṭa su bi shud+dha dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa sarba dharmān/ su bi shud+dha dharma dhā tu swa bhā wān ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa mang du bzlas/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ nas/

kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes pa'i bar mchod pa bcu gnyis 'bul/ de dag ni bum pa sgrub pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas lhag gnas kyi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba/ /'khor ba'i mtsho las bdag sgrol mdzod/ /dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig pu/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ / ces lan gsum/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ / zhes pa lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bzung*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ / thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ / dus 'di nas ni gzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ / so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ / sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*/ /rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/

/ byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ / mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*/ /ma bsgral pa rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / ces lan gsum gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥbadz+ra dan tā kāṣ+ṭha tsa tur bi mok+ṣa mu kha bi shud+dheḥswa bhā waṃ kā ya wāka tsit+ta dz+nyā na mu kha dan ta ā dhi ma laṃ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya swāhā/ rang gi dpral par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la āḥ snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la hūṃ/ lte bar dus ma'i dkyil 'khor la hoḥ gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la haṃ/ gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la k+ṣaḥrnams su gyur/ oṃ a ā aṃ aḥbadz+ra satwa mahā su kha kā la tsakra badz+ra shi ṣ+ya s+ya a bhi mu kho ta bha wa san+tu ṣ+to bha wa wa ra do bha wa kā ya wāka tsit+ta adhiṣ+ṭha naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes lan gsum la sogs pa brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya ste rdo rje sems dpa' bskul ba'o/ /dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ mi zad 'khor bas 'jigs pas bdag ni de ring nyid nas rgyal ba rnams la skyabs su lhag par mchi/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi chu skyes nges par srid par 'jigs 'phrog dag la lus ngag sems ni dag pas so/ / lan gsum/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bla ma dag kyang spyi bos bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen la ni sbyin pa sbyin bgyi 'khor lo 'di la rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig bskyang bar bgyi/

/ral gri la ni mchod pa bgyi ste gsal bar chu skyes rigs la sdom pa dag kyang bskyang bar bgyi/ /sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du rgyal ba bskyed mdzad rigs la byang chub bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /dpral par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ/ sogs gong bzhin bkod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ bdud rtsi myang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs te rang gi snying gar thim/ oṃ aḥr ra ra ra la la la la badz+ra ā be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te ye shes dbab/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ 'tshe dang mi bden gzhan gyi bud med spang bya gzhan gyi nor dang chang gi btung ba de bzhin nyid/ /'khor bar rdo rje'i zhags pa dag ste rang gi dge ba 'joms byed sdig pa lnga po 'di rnams so/ /gang zhig gang gi dus su byung ba'i lha dang mi yi bla ma de yi mtshan gyis rab sbyin bya/ /sna tshogs gtso bo'i bka' 'dis srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa dag ste khyod kyis kyang ni bskyang bar bya/ /cho lo kha na ma tho bcas pa'i zas dang tshig ngan klog dang 'byung po lha min dbang po'i chos/ /ba lang byis pa bud med skyes pa rnams dang lha mi'i bla ma gsod pa lnga ni mi bya'o/ /grogs po rje bo rnams dang lha dang mi yi bla ma dge 'dun yid brtan rnams la 'khu ba yang*/ /dbang po rnams ni kun nas chags pa dag ste de ltar srid pa'i bdag po'i brtul zhugs nyi shu lnga/ / zhes tshar gcig brjod/ srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga po/ /sna tshogs gtso bo'i gsung ji bzhin/ /bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ / lan gsum/ oṃ dwā da sha aṃ ga ni ro dha kā ri ṇe hūṃ phaṭa/ mig dar bcings shing gos ser po bgos par mos/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ lan gcig oṃ āḥhūṃ lan bdun/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ku la bi shwa dha ni swāhā/

zhes me tog phul bar mos/ oṃ di byain+na yā ṇ+yūṭa gha ṭa swāhā/ oṃ di byaya na mud ghā ṭa yā mi swāhā/ zhes mig dar phye bas dkyil 'khor mthong bar mos/ de nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dgu ma phul/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa/ /blo yis blangs nas bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / ces brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ nas/ kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ oṃ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs kyang brjod/ sgrib pa kun spangs dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /bla ma dbyer med ye shes sku khyod la/ /phyi nang mchod rdzas bzang dgu 'bul bar bgyi/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dbang rab stsol/ / ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/ dung chos kyi chu gnas lngar gtor/ oṃ āḥ.ī ṝ ū l̥̄ pañtsa dhā tu bi sho dha ni swāhā/ khams lnga sbyong byed ye shes bdud rtsi 'dis// gnas lngar dbang skur rang bzhin gnyug ma yi/ /gshegs ma yul lnga'i dngos grub myur rtogs nas/ /'bras bu sa ni dang po thob gyur cig /oṃ a i ṛ u l̥ pañtsha ta thā ga ta pa ri shud+dha swāhā/ phung po lnga rnams sbyong byed cod pan 'dis/ / gnas lngar dbang bskur rang bzhin gnyug ma yi/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dngos grub myur rtogs nas/ /'bras bu sa ni gnyis pa thob gyur cig /oṃ a ā aṃ āḥha hā haṃ hā phraiṃ hoḥd sha pa ra mi tā pa ri pu ra ṇi swāhā/ rlung bcu sbyong byed dar dpyangs phreng ba 'dis/

/gnas lngar= /nus ma bcu yi dngos grub myur rtogs nas/ /'bras bu sa ni gsum pa= /oṃ hūṃ hoḥsūr+ya tsan+d+ra bi shwa dha ka swāhā/ ro rkyang sbyong byed rdo rje dril bu 'dis/ /gnas lngar= /gtso bo yab yum dngos grub= / 'bras bu sa ni bzhi pa= /oṃ a ā e ai ar ār o au al āl/ bi ṣa ya in+d+rā ya bi sho dha ni swāhā/ dbang yul sbyong byed me tog sil ma 'dis/ /gnas lngar= /sems dpa' yab yum dngos grub= /'bras bu sa ni lnga pa= /oṃ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā tsa tur+b+ra h+ma bi hā ra bi shud+dhe swāhā/ kye dpal brjod cing gsang ba'i ming dran par bya/ las dbang bya ba sbyong byed gdu bu 'dis/ /gnas lngar= khro bo yab yum dngos grub= /'bras bu sa ni drug pa= /oṃ haṃ k+ṣaḥdharmā tsakra pra bar+dha ka swāhā/ 'gyur bde sbyong byed chos kyi 'khor lo 'dis/ /gnas lngar= /rdor sems yab yum dngos grub= /'bras bu sa ni bdun pa= / slar yang rang gi lag tu rdo rje dang dril bu sbyin par gyur/ nges par rdo rje'i rigs dag la ni srog gcod bya ste ral gri la yang bden pa min pa'i tshig /rin chen la ni gzhan nor dbrog bya mchog gi pad+ma'i rigs nyid la yang gzhan gyi bud med dbrog /chang dang sgron ma sangs rgyas rnams dang bzang po'i yul rnams mtha' dag 'khor lo la ni bskyang bar bya//g.yung mo la sogs mtha' dag bud med rnams ni gri gug la yang mkha' yi pad+mar smad mi bya/ /sems can don gyi slad du nor dang bcas pa'i lus 'di sbyin par bya ste khyod kyis bsrung mi bya/ /rigs kyi bu kye sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba bzhan du mtha' yas bskal pas min par rgyal bas gsungs/ / zhes brjod de nas dam tshig rnams dran par bya ste/ gal te g.yo sgyu'i dbang gis rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung na dmyal bar 'gro ste 'di dag sdug bsngal lo/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dkrugs pa las bu rnams kyi ni rtsa ba'i ltung ba ri bong 'dzin par gyur/

/ de yi bka' las 'gongs pas gzhan du 'gyur te nges par de bzhin spyan la khros pas gsum pa'o/ /byams pa btang bas bzhi par 'gyur tebyang chub sems ni rab tu nyams pa las kyang mda' ru 'gyur/ /drug pa grub pa'i mtha' la smod pa ri bo dag kyang ma smin mi la gsang ba sbyin las so/ /phung po nyon mongs pa las klu ru 'gyur te slar yang dgu pa dag pa'i chos la ma dag gang*/ /rgyu yi byams pa dang ni ming sogs bral ba bde ba ster la rtog pa phyogs dang drag po'o//dag pa'i sems can dag la skyon brjod pa las nyi ma dam tshig thob pa gtong ba las kyang gzhan/ /bud med thams cad la smod nges par ma nur 'gyur te rdo rje'i theg par gnas pa rnams pa'o/ / zhes brjod/ dbang gong ma'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ sgrib pa thams cad bcom pa yi// dus kyi 'khor lo khyod la 'dud/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bdes gang ba/ /ye shes sku khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems ni 'gyur med gang*/ /dbang bskur de yis bdag la ni/ /mgon po da ni bka' drin mdzod/ /bu dang chung ma sogs bcas pa/ /bdag ni dus kun khyod kyi 'bangs/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag la skyabs gzhan yod ma yin/ / ces dbang gong ma spyir gsol ba btab/ oṃ oṃ pradz+nyā u pā yau ka la sha a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā taṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sad pa'i gnas skabs sbyong byed bum dbang gis/ /dge tshul rdo rje 'dzin par dbang bskur bas/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa bas mngon par byang chub ste/ /'bras bu sa ni brgyad pa thob gyur cig /oṃ āḥpradz+nyā u pā yo gu h+ya a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā taṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems myangs shing gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong bar gyur/ rmi lam gnas skabs sbyong byed gsang dbang gis/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin par dbang bskur bas/ /rnam pa nyi shus mngon par byang chub ste//'bras bu sa ni dgu pa thob par shog

/oṃ hūṃ pradz+nyā u pā yo badz+ra satwa bi shwā mā ta rau pradz+nyā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā taṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lag bcangs dang gnyis spyod kyi bde ba 'pho med du myong bar gyur/ oṃ dz+nyā na pū dza a nu rak+to swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gnyid 'thug gnas skabs sbyong byed gsum pa 'dis/ /gnas brtan rdo rje 'dzin par dbang bskur bas/ /rnam pa lnga yis mngon par byang chub ste/ /'bras bu phyogs dang drag po'i sa thob shog /bcom ldan 'das bdag la dbang bskur ba'i rab tu byed pa'i bka' drin gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ chags bral dang po chags pa che/ kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas brjod pa'i chos 'dzin pa/ /rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med/ /bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'chang*/ /cha med cha las 'das pa po/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo 'chang*/ /oṃ hoḥpradz+nyā u pa ya āt+ma kaṃ badz+ra satwa mahā mu dra dz+nyā na ā bhi ṣe kaṃ me pra yats+tsha oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥphaṭa/ dngos po med la sgom pa med/ /sgom pa sgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /chags rtog gnas skabs sbyong byed bzhi pa 'dis/ /skye rgu'i bdag po chen por dbang bskur bas/ /skad cig gcig gis mngon par byang chub ste// 'bras bu sa ni bcu gnyis thob par shog / de nas dam tshig khas blang pa ni/ dus 'di nas ni gzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /sangs rgyas dang ni byang chub sems/ /dpal ldan bla ma khyod spangs nas/ /bla ma gzhan dag rmi lam du'ang*/ /srog dor nas ni bsten mi bya/ /gzhan yang de bzhin dus gsum du// g.yo sgyu med par nus tshad kyis/ /lus ngag sems dang gsum po 'di/ /gtso bo'i spyan sngar dbul bar bgyi/ / de nas rjes ni/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal ba sogs/ bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal dang*/

deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod de dbang bcu gcig gi bdag 'jug ting nge 'dzin tsam gyi sgo nas blang ba'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya'i mchod pa mi byed na/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa kyis gtor ma bsangs pa nas/ 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol gyi bar sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar gtor chog byas la/ 'khor lo'i mchod pa sogs byed na'ang skabs 'dir byed pa yin te/ de dag gi mthar rjes chog bya'o/ /gal te rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya'i mchod pa byed na/ sde drug gi gtor chog kyang de'i zhor la sbyar te chabs cig tu grub par byas na legs so/ /rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa bdun mchod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi mchod pa yang mchod chog mi 'dra ba re re yin pa'i phyir/ sde drug dang so bdun dang drug cu rtsa bzhi rnams gcig gi yan lag tu cig shos nges par sbyor dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor ma so bdun dang drug cu rtsa bzhi gnyis ka dus mnyam du mchod pa la rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya mchod pa zhes grags shing*/ mchod chog logs pa gcig tu 'gyur la/ sde drug gi gtor chog ni/ rnal 'byor ma mchod pa'i yan lag min kyang maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod kyi cha lag tu nges par dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ rigs brgya dang lhan cig tu mchod na thabs shes kyi lha cha tshang zhing 'phrin las mtha' dag sgrub pa la stobs che bar 'gyur bas kyang shin tu legs pa kho na'o/ /de la rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa bdun nam rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor ras bris la sogs pa yod na bkram/ gal de med na maṇ+ḍal zlum skor lnga pa 'dri ba'am/ maṇ+ḍal gcig la lha sum cu rtsa bdun thod pa bzhi dang bcas pa'i tshom bu bkod/ de'i phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du tshom bu dgu pa re re 'god pa'am/ 'bru brdal ba'i maṇ+ḍal zlum po re la tshom bu re re 'god/ rigs sum cu rtsa bdun nam rigs brgya'i tsa ka li yod na legs par bkram/

yang phyi ma 'di maṇ+ḍal logs pa la bkod de maṇ+ḍal gnyis byas kyang rung*/ de'i tshe de la dbus su chos 'byung 'bri ba'am/ tshom bu che ba re 'god do/ /spyir rigs brgya'i 'god tshul la dkyil 'khor gnyis su byas nas gcig la so bdun dang cig shos la dbus su dus kyi 'khor lo'am rdo rje sems dpa'/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du gsung dkyil bzhin ma mo brgyad yab dang bcas pa dang*/ rnam 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi 'god pa'i lugs kyang yod la/ yang lugs gcig la gzhal yas khang sgo rkyang gcig gi sgo'i nang tshun chad du rnal 'byor ma so bdun dang*/ khor yug la rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi 'god pa'i lugs kyang snang ba dang*/ yang so bdun gyi dkyil 'khor nyid la gsung 'khor gyi ma mo brgyad kyi mtha' skor du brgyad pa brgyad kyis bskor ba byed pa'i lugs kyang yod pa de rnams kyang mi rung ba ni ma yin la/ 'on kyang 'dir 'og nas 'chad pa ltar gzhal yas khang phyi nang rim pa gnyis byed pa sgom pa dang lag len la 'khyer bde bas bya la/ 'di ltar gyi tshe rnal 'byor ma brgyad tshar gnyis sgom dgos kyang ngo bo gcig pas rigs brgya'i grangs dang mi 'gal la/ thabs lha chen brgyad zhor byung yin te/ dur khrod gnas pa'i lha dang 'dra'o/ /des na gsung 'khor gyi rtsibs re re la lha dgu dgu 'god pa de ras bris sam tshom bu 'god pa la lag len cung mi bde bar 'ong yang mi rung ba ni ma yin no/ /des na lugs de dag gang mos pa zhig bya ba yin pas maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu 'god tshul yang de dang de las dpags te shes par bya'o/ /gtor ma bsdu na spungs gtor gcig gis chog pa sogs yod kyang rigs sum cu rtsa bdun la phyogs kyi dbye bas bcu gcig zlum gtor mtheb kyu can du byed cing*/ rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi la snod brgyad du zan ril spungs pa rnams bshams dam rdzas rnams dngos su bsre rgyu yod na rab/

med na gzugs brnyan dang ming yig tsam gyis kyang brgyan par bya ba yin mod kyi/ de yang ma grub na yid kyi mos pa tsam gyis kyang mi rung ba ma yin no/ /de dag gi mtha' skor ram mdun du mchod pa rgya cher bshams shing*/ dbus su shing phor shar sogs phyogs bzhir nya phyis be ta thod pa rdza phor rnams mchod yon gyi snod dang*/ de'i rim pas mi lpags/ khyi lpags/ rta lpags ba lang gi pags pa glang chen gyi pags pa rnams kyi sder bza' bca'i snod du bya bar gsungs pa ltar dngos sam gzugs brnyan ji ltar 'byor ba bshams/ slar yang gong du bshad pa ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma la

oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs ba nas/ a mṛ ta ku ru ku ru swāhā 'i bar byin rlabs thams cad thun mong du bya/ sangs rgyas yab yum zhes pa nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa yan chad kyis gtso bo dus kyi 'khor lo sde drug dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul/ de nas maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las 'byung bzhi ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng du rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i steng rdo rje'i gur gyi nang du/ gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyi nang rim pa gnyis lha snam phyogs kyi mdog can du gnas pa/ nang gi lha snam gyi dbus su sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i nang du gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i nang du thugs kyi 'khor lo nag po rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo pad+ma ljang khu 'dab ma brgyad pa ste/ de ltar 'khor lo lnga ni sna tshogs rdo rje dang pad+ma dang ral gri dang gri gug gi 'phreng bas rim pa bzhin du bskor ba'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i pad+mar bzhugs pa ni/ /lte bar mi lpags gdan la g.yung mo ste/ /shar du khyi yi pags par dmangs rigs mo/ /lho phyogs rta yi pags par rgyal rigs ma/ /byang du ba lang pags par bram ze mo/ /nub tu glang chen pags par rje rigs ma/ / mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la snod bzhi ste/ /me ru rkang dang bden bral khrag gi snod/ /dbang ldan dri chu rlung du bshang ba ste/ /zla ba ltar dkar thod pa bdud rtsis gang*/ / thugs 'khor shar du lug lpags mkhar ba mkhan/ /lho ru spyang lpags 'od ma'i gar mkhan ma/ /byang du rnga mo'i pags par nor bu mkhan/ / nub phyogs 'dam seng pags par 'phreng mkhan mo/ /shar lho ra lpags gdan la thags mkhan ma//lho nub ri dwags pags par chang 'tshong ma/ /byang shar bong bu'i pags par gser mkhan mo/ /nub byang phag gi pags par 'phreng rgyud mkhan/

/de yi phyi rol gsung 'khor shar phyogs su/ /chu srin pir gyi pags par sha 'tshong ma/ /lho yi rtsibs la sbal pa karka ṭa'i/ /rus pa'i gdan la mkhur ba mkhan mo dang*/ /byang rtsibs rus sbal khog par gar mgar ma/ /nub rtsibs ma ka ra la tshem bu ma/ /bsreg bzang mgron bu'i phung por rdza mkhan ma/ / srin por nya skam phung por smad 'tshong ma/ /dbang ldan dung dkar steng du tshos mkhan ma/ /rlung phyogs sbal ba'i pags par nya ba mo/ /phyi rol sku 'khor dbang po'i phyogs rtsibs su/ /bse yi pags pa'i gdan la lcags mgar mo/ /lho ru rgya skyegs mkhan mo stag lpags la/ /sre mong pags par til brdung byang du'o/ / srin bal mkhan mo nub tu dom lpags la/ /shar lhor 'bri yi pags par smin ma mkhan/ /lho nub ce spyang pags par shing bzo ma/ /'byung por byi la'i pags par 'dreg mkhan mo/ /rlung mtshams sram gyi pags par ko lpags mkhan/ /phyi rol nam mkha'i 'khor lo'i shar sgo ru/ /go da'i pags par kla klo o ḍi ma/ / lho sgo byi ba'i pags par phyag dar mkhan/ /byang sgo spre'u'i pags par stag gzig mo/ /nub sgo sa li dza ta ka zhes bya'i/ /pags pa'i gdan la gtum mo gdol pa mo/ /me mtshams ri bong pags par smyon thabs mo/ /srin mtshams byi ngur pags par ro sreg ma/ /dbang ldan rtsangs pa'i pags par ri khrod ma/ / nub byang phyogs su i shu ka pa shu'i/ /pags par bhil li mo rnams 'khod par gyur/ /thams cad lang tsho ldan pa'i bud med tshul/ /rang rang las kyi mtha' la gnas par ston/ / slar yang bsang sbyangs/ rigs sum cu rtsa drug gi pho nya mo de rnams stong pa nyid du gyur/ /stong pa'i ngang las dbus su a dang rdo rje las rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/

thabs bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin mi bskyod pa sngon pos 'khyud pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab ma brgyad po rnams la ni/ /i dang ral gri las byung sgrol ma nag mo shar/ /ṛ dang rin chen las byung gos dkar dmar mo lho/ /u dang pad+ma las skyes bdag ma dkar mo byang*/ / l̥ dang 'khor lo las skyes spyan ma ser mo nub/ / gos dkar mo me'i mda' las bskyed par yang bshad pas ci bde bar bya'o/ / mtshams bzhir hī hūṃ hl̥̄ rnams las byung ba'i thod pa bzhi'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs la gnas pa'i lha mo ni/ /ā yig rgyud mang shar phyogs sgra yi rdo rje sngo/ /hāḥyig rdo rje <'od ma'i dbyug > las byung gshin sngon mthon mthing lho/ /aṃ yig chos 'byung las byung chos khams ljang khu byang*/ /haṃ yig tog rtse las skyes drag spyan ljang khu nub/ /aṃ yig dar gos las skyes reg ma nag mo me/ /ār yig chang snod las skyes ro ma dmar mo srin/ / au yig me long las skyes gzugs ma dkar mo dbang*/ /al yig 'khor <me tog 'phreng > lo las skyes dri ma ser mo rlung*/ /de ltar gtso 'khor bcu gsum ni pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /gsung 'khor rtsibs la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams ni/ /shar du ha dang gri gug tsar tsi kā nag mo/ /lho phyogs haḥdang bcu gzar phag mo dmar mo ste/ /byang phyogs haṃ dang rtse gsum drag mo dkar mo'o/ / nub phyogs hā dang khab las dbang mo ser ba'i mdangs/ /shar lhor k+ṣa dang bum pa khyab 'jug mo ni gnag /bden bral k+ṣaḥdang gos ser dmar mo gzhon nu ma/ /dbang ldan k+ṣaṃ dang rdo leb dpal mo zla ba'i mdangs/ / rlung mtshams k+ṣa dang nya <dol > las tshangs ma gser gyi 'od/ /ma mo brgyad po 'di rnams ni sa ga'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /sku 'khor rtsibs la bzhugs pa'i khro mo brgyad po ni/ /dkar min yaḥlas chu gri brtson 'grus ma ni shar/

/ rab dmar raḥlas tshos snod rmugs byed dmar mo lho/ /rab dkar waḥlas ku sha khengs byed ma ni byang*/ /ser 'od laḥlas dar srin rengs byed ma ni nub/ / yā dang smug gdugs las skyes lcags sgrog ma ni nag /rā dang shing lham las skyes khro gnyer can ma dmar/ /wā dang spu gri las skyes skul byed ma ni dkar/ / lā dang mthil lham las skyes 'od zer can ma ser/ /de rnams me srin 'byung po g.yo ba'i phyogs la gnas/ /thams cad kyang g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /sgo mtshams rnams su rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ ba lang ra las shar sgor khyi gdong ma ni gnag /rdza phor las skyes lho sgor phag gdong ma ni dmar/ 'phang las skyes pa byang sgor stag gdong ma ni dkar/ /nub sgor pi wang las skyes ce spyang gdong ma ser/ /gsal shing las skyes shar lhor khwa gdong mig sman mdog /kin na ri las lho nub bya rgod gdong ma dmar/ /rma bya'i sgro las byang shar 'ug gdong chu shel mtshungs/ /shing mda' las 'khrungs nub byang mkha' lding gdong ma ser/ /de rnams n-i zlum po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ / 'khor 'di rnams kyi phyag mtshan sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor las bshad pa ltar sgom pa'am/ bsdu na zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa kho nar byas kyang chog ga ོ / gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i nang gi lha snam la slar yang ma mo brgyad thabs dang bcas pa rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba skad cig gis grub par gyur pa ni/ phyogs dang mtshams su chu skyes dmar dang dkar po la gnas rnal 'byor ma/ / zhes pa nas/ bar bus mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i bar bstod chen las 'byung ba ltar ngag tu brjod cing yid la yang bsam mo/ /spros pa la dga' na 'di rnams kyang sa bon phyag mtshan las bskyed cing*/ rigs brgya'i rnal 'byor ma thams cad la ye shes spyan 'dren gnas gsum byin rlabs dbang bskur rgyas gdab rigs bdag so so'i bar du mtha' rgyas su bya la/

mdor bsdu na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ hūṃ baṃ hoḥhi gnyis su med par thim/ khams gsum dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /rigs brgya rnal 'byor ma tshogs bcas/ /rnam dag rdo rje dri mchog 'di/ / zhes sogs 'don pa spos la mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ oṃ a ā i ī ṛ ṝ u ū l̥ l̥̄ swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥha aḥhaṃ ai ar au al swāhā/ oṃ ha haḥhaṃ hā k+ṣa k+ṣaḥk+ṣaṃ k+ṣā swāhā/ oṃ swāhā/ oṃ yaḥraḥwaḥlaḥya ra wa la swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ hi hī ya yi yu yaṃ swāhā/ oṃ k+ṣī k+ṣī yā yī yū y-ilā yaḥswāhā/ oṃ ra ri ru rl̥ raṃ swāhā/ oṃ rā rī rū rl̥̄ raḥswāhā/ oṃ hu hū wa wi wu waṃ swāhā/ oṃ k+ṣu k+ṣū wā wī wū waḥswāhā/ oṃ hl̥ hl̥̄ la li lu ll̥ laṃ swāhā/ oṃ k+ṣl̥ k+ṣl̥̄ lā lī lū ll̥̄ laḥswāhā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de ltar sngags tshan bcu gsum po re re'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar ba lan gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ de nas/ stong nyid snying rje'i sogs dang*/ phra rab rdul gyi sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ gang gi zhabs ni dran pas kyang*/ /'jigs pa bcu drug las thar mdzad/ /rdzu 'phrul dngos grub stsol mdzad pa/ /rnal 'byor ma tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /de bzhin gshegs yum rnam pa lnga/ /bdud rtsi'i snod dang bcas rnams dang*/ /rdo rje ma drug khro mo gnyis/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo la gnas dang*/ /'chi med na chung ma mo brgyad/ /gsung gi 'khor lo mchog la gnas/ / sku yi 'khor lo bde ba che/ khro mo brgyad po yang dag rol/ /rab gtum chen mo 'jigs rung rnams/ /sgo mtshams dur khrod 'khor lor gnas/ / brgyad pa brgyad kyi rigs byung rnams/ /'jig rten 'phel zad las la brtson/

/ dngos grub stsol ba'i gdong grogs mdzad/ /rigs brgya rnal 'byor gtso mo rnams/ /bye ba bgrang yas tshad med pa'i/ /rnal 'byor ma tshogs rnams la bstod/ /gang la thog mtha' dbus med sogs ye shes lnga'i bstod pa gong bzhin gyi mthar rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ zhes lan mang du brjod pas byin rlabs kha gsos nas/ oṃ a ā i ī ṛ ṝ u ū l̥ l̥̄ swāhā/ zhes pa'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ zhes sogs sde drug gi gtor sngags btags te phul kyang rung mod/ 'on kyang mkha' 'gro ma spyi'i gtor sngags nyid sbyor ba legs pas/ de nyid bod skad du sbyar na nor so chung bas 'di skad ces bya ste/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'khor bcas rnams/ /'di ste gtor ma dri dang me tog dang*/ /bdug spos sgron me ma nyams bdag 'bul gyi/ /'khor dang bcas pa myur du tshur byon la/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'adir ni gtor ma zung*/ /bza' bar mdzod la btung bar mdzad du gsol/ /'khor dang bcas pas sems can rnams la ni/ /zhi rgyas bsrung skyob sba bar mdzad du gsol/ /rang gnas bzhugs la phyi rol dkyil 'khor gyi/ /sa la gnas par mdzod cig hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzod swāhā/ / zhes btags pas gtor ma 'bul/ de bzhin du sngags tshan gzhan rnams re re'i mthar yang gtor sngags de nyid sbyar bas 'bul te/ oṃ k+ṣl̥ k+ṣl̥̄ lā lī lū ll̥̄ lāḥswāhā/ oṃ aḥhūṃ/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams zhes pa nas/ bka' bzhin mdzod swāhā 'i bar sbyar ba'o/ /de nas sde drug nang tshan chos skyong gi gtor ma dang rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma rnams sngar phyogs phyogs su bshams yod na phyogs kyi rim pa dang mthun par byed dgos pas/ shar gyi gtor ma gnyis po de gtong dgos pa yin la/ gtor ma gral sgrigs su bshams yod na zlum gtor bcu gcig gi gral 'go ma de bzhag pa'i de'i 'og nas gral rim du byed dgos pas gral 'go ma'i 'khris kyi zlum gtor de dang spungs gtor brgyad kyi thog ma gcig ste/

de rnams gtor gral nas blangs shar phyogs kyi stegs bu'i steng du bzhag la/ slar yang chab kyis bran nas 'di skad ces gyer ro/ / shar phyogs lha mo sgrol ma 'khor bcas la/ khyi sha khug rta'i sha dang sha khams kyi/ /gtor ma 'di 'bul rlung gi bar chad sol// bsad bskrad dbye ba'i las kun grub par mdzod/ /tsa mun+ṭa la kum+bhir khrung khrung sha /rnag dang bcas pa'i gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi/ /ma mo'i gdon 'joms rims nad zhi bar mdzod/ /shar phyogs 'gro rnams nad med dge bar stsol/ / shin tu stobs mar bse dang hor pa'i sha /rkang dang bcas pa'i gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi bgegs kun zhi bar mdzod/ /sdang dang gdug can thams cad tshar chod cig khyi gdong ma la go dha mig sngon sha /sna yi dri ma bcas pa'i gtor ma 'bul/ /shar gyi phyogs nas 'phrin las kun sgrubs shig/ longs spyod stsol zhing dbang bsgyur dngos grub stsol/ /shar phyogs rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad la/ /so bzhi sen mo gsum dang thod dum gcig /dam rdzas bcas pa'i gtor ma 'di 'bul bas/ /bgegs rnams nyams shing 'dod don grub par mdzod/ /phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /mchod gtor 'di dang dri dang me tog dang*/ / zhes pa nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/ / rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma de rnams phyi rol tu btang ngo*/ /yang de'i rjes kyi 'phro las rnal 'byor ma'i zlum gtor gcig dang spungs gtor gcig shar lhor stegs bu'i steng du bshams 'di skad ces gyer ro/ / shar lho reg bya rdo rje 'khor bcas la/ /ra sha ngur pa'i sha dang bshang lam bcas/ /gtor ma 'di 'bul reg bya'i bar chad sol/ /'gro la reg mchog ster ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ khyab 'jug ma la mgron bu khu byug bcas/ /bad kan bcas pa'i gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi/ /ma mo'i gdon dang rims nad zhi bar mdzad/ /shar lho'i 'gro rnams nad med dge bar stsol/

/lcags sgrog ma la 'bri dang 'ol ba'i sha /mchin par bcas pa gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi/ /shar lho phyogs kyi bgegs kun zhi bar mdzod/ /sdang dang gdug can thams cad tshar chod cig khwa gdong ma la ri bong ne tso'i sha / bshang sgo'i dri mar bcas pa'i gtor ma 'bul/ /shar lho'i phyogs nas 'phrin las kun sgrubs shig /longs spyod 'phel dang dbang bsgyur dngos grub stsol/ / me mtshams rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad la/ /sen mo gnyis dang so bzhi thod dum gnyis/ /dam rdzas bcas pa'i gtor ma 'di 'bul bas/ /bgegs rnams nyams shing 'dod don grub par mdzod/ / mtshams rnams su srung ma drug cu'i gtor ma gtong ba med pas skabs 'dir rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma phyi rol tu dor/ phyogs gzhan gsum dang phyogs mtshams gsum la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma gnyis dang gza'i gtor ma lho phyogs su bteg

lho phyogs lha mo gos dkar 'khor bcas la/ /rta sha sngags can sha dang khrag khams kyi/ /gtor ma 'di 'bul me yi bar chad= / dbang dgug bskyod pa'i las= /phag mor karka ṭa dang srin bya'i sha /lus skyes phrar bcas gtor ma= /ma mo'i= /lho phyogs 'gro rnams= /rmugs byed ma la stag dang bya rog sha /rgyu mar bcas pa'i gtor ma= /lho yi phyogs kyi= /sdang dang = /phag gdong ma la byi ba tsa kor sha /rna ba'i dri mar bcas pa'i= /lho yi phyogs nas= /longs spyod= /lho phyogs rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor ma= /so bzhi= /dam rdzas= bgegs rnams= gza' mchog bcu po 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ / mchod gtor 'di dang = /bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/ / gtor ma gsum po lho phyogs su dor/ yang rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma gnyis lho nub tu bteg la/ lho nub ro yi rdo rje 'khor bcas la/ /ri dwags phug ron sha dang sha khams kyi/ /gtor ma 'di 'bul ro yi= /'gro la ro mchog= /gzhon nu ma la nya dang kyung ka'i sha /srin bur bcas pa'i= /ma mo'i= /lho nub 'gro rnams= khro gnyer can la ce spyang khyim bya'i sha /glo bar= /lho nub phyogs kyi= /sdang dang gdug can= /bya rgod gdong la gzug mo co ga'i sha /bha ga'i dri mar= /lho nub phyogs nas= /longs spyod= / lho nub rgyu ba'i= /sen mo gnyis dang = /dam rdzas= /bgegs rnams= / gtor ma gnyis po lho nub tu dor ro/ /rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma gnyis dang klu'i gtor ma byang phyogs su bteg la/ byang phyogs lha mo bdag ma 'khor bcas la/ /ba lang khu byug sha dang dri chu yi/ /gtor ma 'di 'bul chu yi= /zhi rgyas gzhil ba'i= /drag mo la ni rus sbal so bya'i sha /ba spur bcas pa'i= /ma mo= /byang phyogs 'gro rnams= khengs byed ma la ne'u le 'ug pa'i sha /rus par= /byang gi phyogs kyi= /sdang dang = / stag gdong ma la spre'u pha wang sha /lce'i dri mar= /byang gi phyogs nas= /longs spyod= /byang phyogs rgyu ba'i so bzhi=

/dam rdzas= /bgegs rnams= /klu rgyal bcu po 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /mchod gtor= /mdzad du gsol/ / gtor ma gsum byang du dor/ rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma gnyis byang shar du bteg byang shar gzugs kyi rdo rje 'khor bcas la/ /bong bu bya gar sha rnams mig khams kyi/ /gtor ma 'di 'bul gzugs kyi= /'gro la gzugs mchog= /dpal mo la ni dung dang chu skyar sha /skra dang bcas pa'i= /ma mo'i= /byang shar 'gro rnams= /skul byed ma la byi la khyim bya'i sha /rtsa rgyas bcas pa'i= /byang shar phyogs kyi= /sdang dang = / 'ug gdong ma la rtsangs pa am+bha ri/ /mchan khung dri mar= /byang shar phyogs nas= /longs spyod= /byang shar rgyu ba'i= /sen mo gnyis= /dam rdzas= / bgegs= / gtor ma gnyis byang shar du dor ro/ /yang rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma gnyis dang 'byung po'i gtor ma nub tu bteg la/ nub phyogs lha mo spyan ma 'khor bcas la/ / glang chen ri skeg sha dang bshang khams kyi/ /gtor ma 'di 'bul sa yi= /rmongs rengs gdab pa'i= /dbang mo la ni ma gar sreg pa'i sha /chu ser bcas pa'i= / ma mo'i= /nub phyogs 'gro rnams= /rengs byed ma la dom dang bya rgod sha/ 'khris par bcas pa'i= /nub kyi phyogs kyi= /sdang dang = /ce spyang gdong la sha li dza ta dang*/ /a nī la dang mig dri'i gtor ma 'bul/ /nub kyi phyogs nas= / longs spyod= /nub phyogs rgyu ba'i= /so bzhi= /dam rdzas= bgegs rnams= / 'byung po bcu po 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /mchod gtor= mdzad du gsol// gtor ma gsum po nub phyogs su dor ro/ /rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma gnyis nub byang du bteg la/ nub byang dri yi rdo rje 'khor bcas la/ /phag sha mchil pa'i sha dang sna khams kyi// gtor ma 'di 'bul dri yi= /'gro la dri mchog= /tshangs ma la ni sbal pa bzhad dkar sha /zhag dang bcas= /ma mo'i= /nub byang 'gro rnams= /'od zer can la sram dang rma bya'i sha /pags par bcas pa'i= /nub byang phyogs kyi=

/sdang dang = /mkha' lding gdong la i shu bhe ruṇ+ḍa/ /rtags kyi dri mar= /nub byang phyogs nas= /longs spyod= /nub byang rgyu ba'i= /ser mo gnyis= /dam rdzas= / bgegs rnams= / gtor ma gnyis nub byang du dor/ steng du rnal 'byor ma'i zlum gtor gcig dang zad par gyi gtor ma gtong dgos pas khang steng ngam/ shar gyi shar du gtor ma gnyis po bteg la/ steng phyogs chos khams rdo rje 'khor bcas la/ /rnga mong ngang pa'i sha dang bha gar bcas/ /gtor ma 'di 'bul chos khams= 'gro la chos mchog= / drag chen ma la seng ge bya khra'i sha /snying dang bcas pa'i= /steng gi phyogs kyi= / sdang dang = /zad par bcu po 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /mchod gtor= / mdzad du gsol/ / gtor ma gnyis po steng du dor/ rnal 'byor ma'i zlum gtor gcig dang*/ khro bcu'i gtor ma nub kyi nub tu bteg la/ 'og phyogs sgra yi rdo rje 'khor bcas la/ / lug dang ba lang sha dang rna ba yi/ /gtor ma 'di 'bul sgra yi bar chad sol/ / 'gro la sgra mchog ster ba'i 'phrin las mdzad/ /sngon mor 'brog dgon khyi dang ljon shing sgra/ /tshil bur bcas pa'i gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi/ /'og gi phyogs kyi bgegs kun zhi bar mdzod/ /sdang dang gdug can thams cad tshar chod cig khro rgyal bcu po 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /mchod gtor 'di dang = /bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/ / gtor ma gnyis po nub phyogs thag ring sa'am dor sa yod na 'og phyogs su dor/ rnam 'byor ma'i gtor ma zlum gtor gral 'go ma kha gsos chab kyis bran/ dpal ldan rdor dbyings dbang phyug 'khor bcas la/ /shu kra me tog dam rdzas thams cad kyi/ /gtor ma 'di 'bul bar chad thams cad sol/ /las dang dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /rigs brgya rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / gi bar spyi dang mthun par brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya/

gtor ma de yang khang steng du 'bul lo/ /yang tshogs mchod byed na'ang skabs 'dir bya ste/ tshogs rdzas 'dus byas la/ oṃ phraiṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī zhes pa nas/ da lta nyid du gnas par shog / gi bar tshogs mchod kyi cho ga bdud rtsi 'khyil bar bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /de nas rjes chog ni mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe gan+dha artsa nāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ su ra ta pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā 'i bar gyis mchod rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ mchog sbyin rdo rje sogs kyis gong bzhin bstod/ spro na rgyud gzhan las 'byung ba'i rdo rje'i glu yang blang*/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje/ nus mthu'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ spyir phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs shing*/ zhal bzhugs pa rnams sku khams bzang ba dang*/ khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnas skabs su yang sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ ji ltar yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad 'bad pa med par 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsol ba drag tu btab/ steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bdud kyi phyogs gnas lha ma yin rnams mchog tu 'jigs byed dang*/ /mi yi 'jig rten dag na phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas khro bo'i rgyal po btsun mor bcas rnams dang*//

sa 'og dag na gdengs can dbang po gang dag gdon tshogs mi dge dus kun tu ni 'ching byed pa/ /de rnams thams cad nyin zhag so so'i dus su mi shes 'jig rten kun nas skyong par byed gyur cig /oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs kyis shis pa brjod/ yig brgya mang du bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ /mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod/ /gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pas/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ /'dir ni bya ba gang nongs pa/ / de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ /oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / sogs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ gsang bar haṃ yig la sogs kyis srung ma drug cu yang rang gi lus la bstims/ bris sku dang tsa ka li sogs rten rnams la brtan bzhugs spyi dang mthun par bya/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rang nyid la thim/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams du ba la sogs lam gyis lhan skyes bde ba mchog bsgoms te/ /'gro ba'i bla ma sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan sku ni chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag gnas/ /lha rnams mgo yi gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer tshogs kyis zhabs kyi pad+ma la gtugs shing*/ /dam pa'i lam ston nyin byed bzhin du mun pa kun 'joms dus kyi 'khor lo nyid gyur cig /nyi ma dang bcas thub pa'i rigs rnams kyis ni shes rab ye shes thob par gyur 'di ji lta bar/ / rnam gsum srid par gnas pa'i sems can rnams ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i drin las e waṃ nyid gyur cig /skyes bu gang dag bdud kyi grogs kyis rtag tu mi bden mun par song zhing lam nyams pa/ de rnams lam 'di thob nas rdo rje nor bu'i khyim dang ring ma min par 'ong gyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag rnal 'byor ma thob rab tu g.yo ba'i yid kyis gal te shi bar gyur na yang*/

/dpal ldan mi yi 'jig rten du ni rab mchog thub pa'i rigs su rnal 'byor ldan par skye ba dang*/ /sngon gyi goms pa de yis slar yang ye shes rnal 'byor yangs pa dag ni kun tu 'dzin pa dang*/ /ye shes thob nas mi zad mchog gi gnas su rab bgrod slar yang gang du'ang skye ldan min gyur cig /dgra dang seng ge glang chen dbang po me dang ltos 'gro'i bdag dang chom rkun zhags pas 'ching*/ /chu gter 'khrugs dang sha za 'chi ba'i 'jigs byed nad dang dbang po'i nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/ /dbul dang bud med dang bral mi bdag 'khrugs pa'i 'jigs dang rdo rje ltung dang don nyams rnams/ /bdag gis rnal 'byor ma rnams zhabs ni gsal bar dran pa'i mthu las rab tu nyams gyur cig /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dus kyi 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ /bsnyom med dus kyi 'khor lo ston/ /bla ma la gus snying brtse ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*/ / btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ / bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ ces sogs smon lam ji ltar 'os pa btab/ de nas dril sil me tog rol mo sogs dang bcas pas 'di skad ces brjod de/ bkra shis 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma dang*// bkra shis rang bzhin dus kyi 'khor lo la/ /bkra shis 'gro la spel phyir phyag 'tshal nas/ /bkra shis rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs brjod par bya/ /pad+ma'i lte bar bdud dang drag po'i steng*/ /rol pa'i gdan bzhugs bde ba chen po'i sku/ /stong chen 'od gsal sna tshogs yum dang sbyor/ /bde stong dus kyi 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog

/rnam bcu dbang ldan 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /pha rol phyin bcu rnam dag lha mo bcu/ /rdo rje bzhi yi grwa nas rab mdzes pa/ /bde chen 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /phung po rnam dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs/ khams drug dag pa'i yum dang mnyam par sbyor/ /'chi med grub pa'i bum pas rab brgyan pa/ /rgyal ba'i 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog / dbang po rnam dag byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ /yul drug dag pa'i lha mos rab tu 'khyud/ /gdod nas zag med bde ba'i dpal 'byor can/ /sems dpa'i 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /las dbang rnam dag khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /bya ba rnam dag khro mor mnyam par sbyor/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal/ khro rgyal 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog/ lte ba'i rtsa rnams dag pa lha mo'i tshogs/ /tsartsi kā sogs gzhan mchog chos kyi dbyings/ /zung 'jug rol pa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas/ /gsung gi 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /las dang bya ba'i 'khor lo rnam dag pa// don dam lha chen bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas/ /mthil bzhi gsang gtsug rnam dag shing rta dpung*/ /sku yi 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /sor mo rnam dag klu dang gtum mo'i tshogs/ /'dod yon dga' bde'i rang bzhin gzugs kyi lha/ /skra dang ba spu rnam dag grub pa dang*/ /'byung po'i 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /gza' dang drang srong rgyu skar khyim dang cha/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong pho nya 'phrog ma dang*/ /ghaṇ+ḍa kar+ṇa dga' byed nag po che/ /bhṛṃ gi ni sogs 'khor gyi'ang bkra shis shog /don dam skyabs gsum thugs gsung sku yi bdag / lhun grub ye shes 'od gsal gzhal yas khang*/ /chos sku'i yon tan 'od kyi dra ba can/ /dkyil 'khor chos dbyings chen po'i bkra shis shog /dkyil 'khor bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho'i dbyangs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros rgya mtsho'i sgras/

/rnam par bsgrags te skye rgu rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa la sogs pa bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ji ltar 'os pa brjod do/ /de ltar na dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lha dgu'i sgrub thabs nyams su len pa rnams la nye bar mkho ba mchod pa'i cho ga cha tshang mdo tsam 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas dpal gyi jo nang du smras pa'o// //maṅgalaṃ/ zhus dag / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i mchod chog nyer mkho bzhugs/ -PAGE 64--PAGE 63--PAGE 21- EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
